title: Three- and four-stranded nucleic acid structures and their ligands
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00287C, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yoshiki Hashimoto, Sumit Shil, Mitsuki Tsuruta, Keiko Kawauchi, Daisuke Miyoshi
Nucleic acids have the potential to form not only duplexes, but also various non-canonical secondary structures in living cells. Structure- and sequence-selective binding of small molecules is required for their cellular applications.
